TRANSITION SERVICES AGREEMENT

This agreement is made between Copperline Inc. and Driftwood Co. regarding transition services.

Section 1. Term. This agreement continues for two years.

Section 9. Assignment. Neither party may assign this agreement without consent. Upon a change in ownership of either party, the other party must give prior written consent before any transfer of rights.

Agreed and signed. Signature: Casey Lin for Copperline. Signature: Robin Park for Driftwood.

evidence.quote: Upon a change in ownership of either party, the other party must give prior written consent before any transfer of rights.

expected.rationale: Ownership-change trigger with a prior-written-consent consequence on page 2. Signed by both parties; no liability language present.
